neighbours.label: the piece ' bef' in befell / befriended (with ' emergence' and 'lic' of frolic as unexplained neighbours)
fire: Nobody can say what befell the sailors on that voyage.
A terrible fate befell the village in the winter of 1812.
As a lonely boy he was befriended by the old gardener.
Soon she befriended a stray dog behind the bakery.
Misfortune befell the family after the mill burned down.
The new teacher quickly befriended most of her pupils.
We learned at last what befell the missing explorers.
In prison he befriended a forger who taught him to paint.
quiet: Nobody can say what happened to the sailors on that voyage.
A terrible storm hit the village in the winter of 1812.
As a lonely boy he was helped by the old gardener.
Soon she adopted a stray dog behind the bakery.
Poverty came to the family after the mill burned down.
The new teacher quickly learned most of her pupils' names.
We learned at last what became of the missing explorers.
In prison he met a forger who taught him to paint.
